text:
PriyaK: Quick sync after the postmortem - we need clear owners for the small but persistent span-loss pattern we've been seeing. Suggest split work: detection+alerting, instrumentation parity, aggregator reconciliation, and ETL throttling.
AlexM: Agree. This is the recurring problem pattern we flagged in the postmortem. Let's assign and get ETAs. Keep updates here.
MartaG: I'll take detection & alerting. Plan: implement a rolling-month detector that flags low-rate ongoing loss (>0.1% daily avg for 7 days) and ties to deploys. Will add a dashboard panel and an incident playbook link. ETA: 4 days.
SamT: I'll own instrumentation parity and sampler audit. Action: add sampled-vs-ingested counter, wire to alert thresholds, and add unit + integration tests for sampling edge cases. Canary plan included. ETA: 6 days.
JinR: Aggregator reconciliation here. I'll build a nightly reconcile job that compares raw spans vs rollups and emits drift metrics, plus a small re-aggregation tool to fix buckets under threshold. ETA: 7 days.
AlexM: ETL backlog handling?
PriyaK: I'll work on ETL throttling and retry shaping to avoid retry storms causing late-arrival that breaks aggregation windows. Add queue-depth alarms and a safe-mode fallback to accept-but-mark for later re-agg. ETA: 5 days.
observability-bot: Created tasks TKT-8021 (detection-rule), TKT-8022 (sampler-audit), TKT-8023 (reconciler), TKT-8024 (etl-shaper).
analytics-team: For acceptance we'll need: 1) detector alert firing on synthetic loss test, 2) sampler metric within 0.3% of expected under stress, 3) reconciliation run shows drift <0.15% after fixes, 4) ETL latency SLO met during replay. We can provide baseline queries.
SamT: PR up for sampler counters: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/8799. Tests: stress harness and region canary for 12h.
MartaG: Detector rule draft: https://dash.redwood/rules/8021 (WIP). Includes linking to deploy metadata to suppress false positives during known platform changes.
JinR: Reconciler prototype: https://git.redwood/aggregator/PR/4420. Nightly job will emit reconciler.report. Need analytics to sanity-check thresholds.
PriyaK: ETL shaping PR: https://git.redwood/etl/PR/2238. Replay slot booked for Saturday 02:00 UTC. Will coordinate with infra.
AlexM: Please paste your short validation steps here when PRs are ready. Also add yourself to the postmortem remediations table with ETA. We'll do a 72h checkpoint in this thread.
SamT: Validation steps: 1) run synthetic sampler test (10M traces) 2) compare sampled-vs-ingested <0.3% 3) smoke dashboard alerts.
MartaG: Detector test: inject synthetic 0.2% drop for 10 days in staging, ensure alert triggers and suppression semantics work.
JinR: Reconciler test: run night job against a week of production-like data in staging and verify drift metric aligned with analytics baseline.
PriyaK: ETL test: replay historical backlog on staging with shaped retries, confirm 95th latency < SLA and no duplicate aggregation markers.
analytics-team: We'll run the validation and post artifacts here. Also we'll sign off on any re-agg before it runs.
AlexM: 72h checkpoint: owners post progress and blockers.
SamT: 72h update: sampler PR merged to main, canary started in eu-west, metrics look stable so far.
MartaG: 72h update: detector rule implemented, dashboard panel in place, fine-tuning thresholds now.
JinR: 72h update: reconciler tests passing locally, hitting an intermittent DB timeout in CI. Investigating.
PriyaK: 72h update: ETL shaping merged, replay scheduled, infra confirmed capacity, runbook added for on-call.
observability-bot: Reminder: TKT-8023 reconciler nightly job scheduled at 02:00 UTC daily.
AlexM: Thanks. Once analytics runs validation after canary and nightly reconciles look good for one week, we'll close action items. Add a calendar reminder for a 2-week post-deploy health check focused on recurrence detection.
MartaG: Done 12; added note to postmortem and set the 2-week check.
analytics-team: We'll post the validation results here after the nightly job completes.
AlexM: Closing note - please ensure runbooks reference the safe-mode fallback and include rollback conditions for quick reversion.
PriyaK: Runbook updated with rollback and escalation steps.
SamT: Canary complete, no regression, promoting sampler metrics globally.
JinR: CI fixed, reconciler running in staging; will monitor first run.
analytics-team: Validation pass for initial checks. Will continue monitoring for recurrence.
AlexM: Action items owning and timelines recorded; keep monitoring and report any regression in this thread. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
